body: Let me do a quick sanity check on the critical region of the written file.

Done.

**File changed:** `crates/sniff-engine/src/document.rs` (new file, 332 lines)

**Public API:**
- `#[must_use] pub fn parse(value: &serde_json::Value) -> sniff_core::modern::DocumentFacet` — uses an explicit `tracing::debug!(has_title = …, links = …, "parsed __document facet")` event at the top (per Main's correction; no `#[tracing::instrument]`, since `tracing-attributes` isn't a dependency).

**Private helpers:** `string_or_none`, `bool_or_false`, `media_or_all`, `parse_meta` (BTreeMap, string values only), `parse_array` (preserves DOM order; non-object elements fall back to defaults).

**Behavior:** string-or-null optionals, bool flags, `media` defaults to `"all"` on missing/null/empty/non-string, sorted `meta`, array order preserved, wrong-typed fields default, no panics, no `unwrap()`/`expect()`.

**Tests added (7):** full document (all fields), empty `{}` → `DocumentFacet::default()`, meta ordering independent of insertion order, blocked cross-origin stylesheet, bare `<style>` with `href: null` (both empty and missing `media`), links/scripts with null optionals + unknown keys, and malformed scalars (`title: 42`, `links: "oops"`, non-object array items) falling back without panicking. All compare via `assert_eq!` against typed structs.

**Note for integrator:** the actual `sniff_core::modern::LinkInfo` has a 6th field `crossorigin: Option<String>` not present in the contract description I was given; I parse it from the `crossorigin` key (missing → `None`) so the struct constructs correctly. No cross-slice requests or blockers. Gates skipped as instructed.
